pick.name: Infisical
pick.what: Secrets manager; `infisical run -- <cmd>` injects env at runtime; syncs to hosts/CI
pick.why: Plaintext secrets never sit on disk where Claude can read them; syncs to Cloudflare/Vercel/GitHub; MIT core self-hostable
pick.free_limits: Free: 5 identities, unlimited projects, 3 environments, 10 syncs, no secret versioning/rotation; Pro $20/identity/mo annual ($23 monthly)
pick.install: scoop bucket add infisical https://github.com/Infisical/scoop-infisical.git; scoop install infisical

alts.name: SOPS + age
alts.what: Encrypt yaml/json/env with age or cloud KMS
alts.why: No vendor; CNCF; good for regulated work

decision: With an AI agent reading your working tree, runtime injection beats any on-disk .env. Switch to dotenvx or SOPS if you want zero vendors.

verify.note: Free: 5 identities, unlimited projects, 3 environments, 10 secret syncs; no versioning/PIT recovery, rotation or dynamic secrets. Pro $20/identity/mo annual ($23 monthly). MIT core self-hostable.
